fields.label: API Base URL
fields.description: Mswipe PBL API endpoint. Leave blank to use the default production URL.

fields.label: Customer Code
fields.description: Mswipe-assigned customer/merchant code provided during onboarding.

fields.label: Mswipe API User ID
fields.description: API user ID issued by Mswipe for the Pay-by-Link service — not your ERPNext login.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: Client / application ID provided by Mswipe.

fields.label: Mswipe API Password
fields.description: API password issued by Mswipe for the Pay-by-Link service — not your ERPNext login.

fields.label: Mode of Payment
fields.description: ERPNext Mode of Payment used when creating Payment Entries. Must have a default account set for your company.

fields.label: System User
fields.description: ERPNext user under whose name Payment Entries will be created.
